name: Gatekeeper (Alien Reaper Overlord)
comment: Shoots his bolt (379497: a projectile, 15 m, ×1.0) and spawns four Alien Pods on the points north, east, south and west of himself (379720, every 16.4 s within 15 m, up to 5 alive: his counter 440771), each beamed from him by its spawn visuals (440781, effect 464434: 3 s stunned); the client's spells, the user's memory (2026-10-30).
